description:
On the /fly route, the HUD velocity readout shows 'NaN km/s' for all outer-planet missions (Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto) throughout the entire flight

Expected: The HUD velocity readout displays a finite, physically plausible heliocentric speed in km/s for every mission destination

Acceptance criteria:
- heliocentricSpeed(rAu, aTransferAu) must never return NaN for any finite, positive inputs — Math.sqrt must only be called on a non-negative radicand [code-invariant: NaN is always an invalid numerical display state; the app must never surface NaN to the user]
- When the vis-viva radicand (2/rAu - 1/aTransferAu) would be negative (rAu > 2*aTransferAu), heliocentricSpeed must return a fallback — the circular-equivalent speed at rAu: sqrt(MU_SUN_AU3_YR2 / rAu) * AU_PER_YR_TO_KMS [spec: heliocentricSpeed docstring at fly-physics.ts:37-48 — states it returns 'speed in km/s' computed via vis-viva; when inputs produce a hyperbolic/escape parameter regime relative to the transfer ellipse, the circular-equivalent speed at the current radius is the conventional finite fallback]
- heliocentricSpeed(0, aTransferAu) must return 0 (division by zero guard) [repo-data: MU_SUN_AU3_YR2/Math.PI constants in fly-physics-constants.ts: 2/0 is infinite; the function must guard against rAu === 0]

Domain facts:
- Hohmann transfer semi-major axes for outer planets: Earth→Jupiter ≈ 3.1 AU, Earth→Saturn ≈ 5.25 AU, Earth→Uranus ≈ 10.1 AU, Earth→Neptune ≈ 15.55 AU, Earth→Pluto ≈ 20.25 AU (standard orbital mechanics derivable from destination planet semi-major axes)

Target: src/lib/orbital/fly-physics.ts — heliocentricSpeed
Do NOT change src/routes/fly/+page.svelte (the flyHeliocentricSpeed(scR, ...) consumption at line 952 — the NaN appears there in the HUD, but it is generated inside heliocentricSpeed, not by the consumer) — it is not the owner of this symptom.
